GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.title: Gu Hand
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.descriptio: The Gu Hand stores up to 5 usable Gu Worms. When space is available, recovered Gu are drawn at random from the recovery pile. Killer Move deduction can use only Gu in this pile. An affordable Activate in your normal hand lets you play a Gu.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.title: Gu Recovery Pile
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.descript: Stores cooling Gu and recovered Gu waiting because the Gu Hand is full. At turn start, vacancies are filled at random. Left-click to inspect; right-click and spend 1 Energy to deduce a Killer Move using materials only from the Gu Hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.empty: The Gu Recovery Pile is empty.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_SHA_ZHAO_MATERIAL.d: Stores Gu Worms sealed into Killer Moves. Materials return to the Gu Recovery Pile when the Killer Move is consumed or dismantled.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.selectionP: Select Gu Worm materials matching the selected Killer Move, then confirm.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.targetSele: First select the Killer Move to deduce. Only matching materials will be shown next.
